prompt: Create a test fixture with a broken builds-on reference, run /builder:lint --paths-only, verify S2 fires for the bad reference but not the valid one, then delete fixture and confirm idempotency.

assertions.text: An ALIGNMENT-DEBT.md entry is written for DOES-NOT-EXIST.md (S2 finding)
No ALIGNMENT-DEBT.md entry is written for 01-evaluation-loop.md (valid reference not flagged)
Second lint run (after fixture deletion) adds zero new entries for the fixture path
Fixture file _test-fixture.md does not exist after the run completes
